what: The Owner's production measurement that caused this round, recorded as reported. Not taken by the agent; nothing in this file was re-derived or completed by inference.
measuredBy: Owner (vic.zhou@shopkitchenmama.com), on Production, after setting KM_FX_RATE_BOOK_EDITORS by hand

reported.Session.getActiveUser: threw - the manifest's explicit oauthScopes do not include https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email

howTheCodeTurnsThatIntoTheRefusal: 75_ fxBookDefaultIo_().user() wraps Session.getActiveUser().getEmail() in try/catch and returns '' on a throw.
fxBookAuthority_ finds the allowlist set (so not FX_AUTHORITY_NOT_CONFIGURED) and the caller '' -> FX_AUTHORITY_UNVERIFIABLE.
So the page showed the same code the runbook explained only as 'execute-as-owner cannot see the caller'. The measured cause was a missing scope, which is a different fault with a different fix.
notMeasured: Whether getActiveUser returns the Owner's address once the scope is granted. That needs the Owner's sync + re-consent + one more fxRateBook.get; until then it is expected, not proved.
The exact exception text. It was reported as a missing-permission error naming userinfo.email; it is not quoted here because it was not captured verbatim.
decision: Owner approved a LOCAL change adding only userinfo.email to oauthScopes. Production unchanged in this round. executeAs, access, the OAuth client, every .gs file and the generated bundle are unchanged.
